name: Geneva-tail knuckle on the pin knee: link 2's rear tail turns K through a one-tooth intermittent drive, so q2's encoder determines K (3 active, no K sensor)
family: redundant 4R with a determined spare (cam-slaved knuckle)
lens: round6:cam-stop-knuckle (3 active, no K sensor)
description: minarc B (pin knee + spring knuckle K splitting link 1) with the J2 hard stop replaced by a ONE-tooth Geneva-style drive. Link 2's Ti strap continues backward past hub 2 as a rigid tail (L_t ~39-41 deg, derived from bk2 so the roller passes 6-8 mm from K's axis) with an MR63ZZ roller at its tip. K's stack is flipped (link 1a upper); its +6 mm clock-spring cap carries one radial (or curved) tooth flank at r 4-10 mm. At rest and through the 3R window K sits on stop A and the tail swings clear: the chain is H1-like. Past the stretched onset (smhi) link 1b and link 2 come near collinear, the tail lies back along link 1b, its roller pushes the tooth and K opens by dK(q2) = atan(L_t t / d) until a q2 dowel stop B; the clock spring keeps the tooth on the roller. The folded side has NO lobe (one tooth only). K is never read: (q1, q2, q3) give the arm pose. 0 passive translations; no gear, cable or pulley. FALLBACK EMBODIMENT (merged lobe-rocker-pushrod-knuckle-3r): a lobe on hub 2's rotor rim + a rocker on link 1b + an O3 pushrod with M3 rod ends to a horn on K's cap - no swinging metal, but kK <= ~3.5 by pressure angle and complexity ~42.5.
topology: scapula handler -> J1 (ACTIVE, O20 R through GH) -> link 1a (upper member at K; cap carries the tooth) -> K (PASSIVE R, slaved: clock spring onto stop A, or onto the tail roller past the onset) -> link 1b -> J2 (ACTIVE, O20; q2 dowel stop B after the tooth) -> link 2 + rigid rear tail (roller on K's tooth: closed loop link1b-J2-link2/tail-tooth-link1a-K) -> member 3 / pin knee as in skin-normal-3r-pin-knee (pins a, b PASSIVE R, closure-determined) -> J3 (ACTIVE, O20) -> arm pad on BOTTOM
components: J1, K, J2, J3: v5 O20 x 12.25 hubs on MR117-2RS pairs (Keep O20 only). K cap +6 mm with a 0.3 x 5 mm 1.4310 clock-spring strip (45 N.mm preload). Tail: integral extension of link 2's 8 x 3 Ti-6Al-4V bent bar, ~38-42 mm, ~4 g. Roller: MR63ZZ (3 x 6 x 2.5) on an O3 h6 dowel, boss O8 x 4. Tooth: 3 mm flank on K's cap rim (wire-EDM Ti or pressed hardened 1.4034 insert), curved where dK > 45 deg. Stops A (K) and B (J2): O2 ISO 8734 dowels in arc slots. Pin knee pins a, b: iglidur GSM sleeves + GTM washers on Ti pins, as in H1. Contact ~5.6 N preload / 15 N design, line Hertz ~195 MPa vs 880 MPa yield.

Gate 1: th(q2) monotone on the lobe; the coupling relieves the J2 rate ratio (0.38-1.92 vs 2.74-3.45). Measured dK_max 51.7 deg -> radial-flank pressure angle ~dK > 45: curve the flank or cap dK at 45.
model_spec: Start from the proposer's scratch patch camB.py (copies KRDesign._ik_phys of docs/concepts/models/minarc-stop-knuckle-4r-kitrule.py and scans q2 past the onset with dK = c(t)); port to docs/concepts/models/geneva-tail-knuckle-pinknee-3r.py. FIRST (red team): kK_lo = 0 (no folded lobe); replace the linear c(t) by the exact tooth contact: roller centre c(q2) = R(u2,q2) c0 (tail tip, arc L_t behind J2, at F2 + h_tail), flank plane through K's axis in link 1a's frame (optionally an arc of radius rho_f), contact n(dK).(c(q2) - x_K) = rho_roller -> A cos dK + B sin dK = C (Paden-Kahan), K = max(stop A, tooth), root continuous with 0. L_t derived from bk2 +- d. SECOND, before any CMA: add the tail strap member (8 x 3, rigid with link 2, over link 1b +1 mm and over hub K's crown+cap except the roller), the O8 x 4 roller keep-out and the tooth sector on hub K (t = CROWN + capK, flipped stack); K6 on every new pair (roller-tooth exempt only on poses where the law says they touch, else >= 1 mm). description: The verified winner (geneva-tail-knuckle-pinknee-3r, rod) with its drive replaced. Same chain, seats and K arcs (bk1 31.25, bk2 37.99). The rocker, O3 pushrod, both M3 rod ends and the horn go. Link 1a (the upper member at K) grows an integral lug, 23.5 mm from K's axis, aimed about 2 deg off the K-J2 line, carrying an O5 follower. Link 2 carries a 3 mm plate around hub 2 that drives the follower. Law: dK = kK t over q2's stretched travel t past the onset, kK about 0.6 (dK 36 deg over 60 deg of q2), onset earlier than the winner (smhi about 28). Embodiment 'roller' (the proposer's idea): an MR52ZZ roller on a 26-deg lobe sector (pitch 14.3-24.1 mm off u2, outer 26.6 mm), K returned to stop A by its clock spring; on the folded side and in state A the sector turns away from the roller. Embodiment 'groove' (merged from groove-arm-knuckle-3r): an O3 pin in an iglidur sleeve runs in a 5.2 mm groove whose dwell arc (circle r 14.3 about u2) holds K at rest over q2's whole state-A range and whose rise is the same law; no clock spring, no stop A, hub K 6 mm lower, K positively determined at every q2 (no lift-off, no force-closure question). The screen measures both embodiments; the groove's folded second rise is NOT searched (the two-rise-lobe screen killed folded relief on link 1).

name: Slipper-nose knuckle: the drive's roller deleted (hardened O3 nose sliding on the flank) - re-aimed onto the lead (cx 24.25 -> 22.0), with the proposer's kneeless + hub-3 wedge chain (20.12 frozen) as the measured control

lens: round10:low-complexity-at-the-lead's-reach (lens 3; re-aimed onto the lead after simplicity v2)
description: One change to the roller-flank drive: the MR63ZZ roller at the tip of the crank's bent long arm is deleted, and the arm ends in a pressed, hardened, polished O3 440C nose that slides on the conjugate flank milled into link 1a's boss (flank = the nose-centre path offset by 1.5 mm instead of 3; the smaller contact radius lowers the horn pressure angle at a given stroke by ~3 deg, which pays for the friction angle). Primary cell: the lead roller-longdyad-knuckle-3r (pin knee, b3 tilt): its stroke is set by the horn pressure angle (dK_lim 46.5, horn PA 42.8), so at a kinematic cap of 40 + atan(mu) the stroke and the metal stay the lead's and the roller's bearing, axle and body go. The wedge is reported as its own column on both cells (on the lead it can remove at most the 0.63-point in-band term). At rest, overhead, across the body and behind the back the metal is the parent's.

name: Groove-desmo knuckle: spring-free positive K drive (roller in a closed slot, O1.5 follower dowel in a groove under hub 2's cap), stops merged into the groove ends; groove re-sized to fit the O20 cap; re-aimed onto the lead (cx 22.0)
family: slaved-knuckle 3R, positive-motion drive (lead family with the free pin knee; kneeless control)
lens: round10:low-complexity-at-the-lead's-reach (lens 3; re-aimed onto the lead after simplicity v2)
description: Both cam pairs of the roller-flank drive made positive, so K needs no spring. At the K end the conjugate flank becomes a closed two-walled slot in link 1a's boss (inner wall merged into hub K's boss; contact r ~16-22 mm) with an MR52ZZ roller captured in it. At hub 2 the rim lobe becomes a track groove in the underside of hub 2's cap ring, over a link-2 boss reduced to O12 on the crank side; a hardened dowel on the crank's short arm rides in it at link 2's level (link 2's exit at hub 2 never comes within 69.3 deg of the crank side on kneeless's 184 taken fit poses). K's clock spring, its 6 mm cap and stop A are deleted: the groove's dwell holds K both ways and its ends are stops A and B. Judge re-size: the proposal's O2 dowel and 2.02 groove span r 6.59-9.91 in an r-10 cap (outer wall 0.09 mm), so the follower becomes an ISO 8734 1.5 m6 dowel in a 1.52 groove with the pitch radius held in [7.06, 8.44] (0.8 mm outer wall, 0.3 mm off the O12 boss): radial rise <= 1.38 mm, i.e. s_arm <= 3.85 for a 20.5-deg crank stroke (kneeless: base 7.1 / s_arm 3.6 / crest 8.4 fits) and s_arm <= 4.2 for the lead's 18.7-deg stroke (base ~7.06 / s_arm 4.05 / crest 8.38 fits). Primary cell: the lead (pin knee free, b3 tilt); control: kneeless-roller. Metal at rest, overhead and across the body is the parent's minus the 6 mm spring cap, plus the slot's outer wall 1.5 mm beyond the roller path.
topology: scapula handler -> J1 (ACTIVE R, O20) -> link 1a (+ slotted boss) -> K (PASSIVE R, O20, plain cap, no spring; positively slaved, never read) -> link 1b -> J2 (ACTIVE R, O20) -> link 2 -> J3 (ACTIVE R, O20) -> member 3 -> pin a (PASSIVE R) -> knee link -> pin b (PASSIVE R) -> pad (unsensed knee) -> arm [control: rigid bracket]. Drive loop, positive both ways: groove under hub 2's cap -> O1.5 follower dowel (SLIDING) on the bell crank (PASSIVE R, MR63ZZ pair on link 1b) -> bent long arm -> MR52ZZ roller (PASSIVE R, rolling) in link 1a's double-flank slot -> K.
components: 4 x O20 MR117-2RS hubs (plain cap on K). Crank: MR63ZZ pair in the O10 x 6 boss on link 1b. Follower: ISO 8734 1.5 m6 x 6 hardened dowel in a 1.52 +0.01/0 x 1.5 deep groove (wire-EDM / 5-axis) under hub 2's cap, pitch r 7.06-8.44. Roller: MR52ZZ (2x5x2.5) on an integral O2 stub of the crank arm, in a 5.02 +0.01 slot (wire-EDM) in link 1a's boss, outer wall 1.5 mm. Link-2 boss O12 around the MR117's O11 ring (0.5 mm wall: stated on the part). K slop ~+-0.6 deg (crank 0.015 / s_arm x g + slot 0.04 deg). The clock spring and the stop-A pin are removed. why_better: Proposer, kneeless-roller model at its verified params: capK 6 -> 0 changes nothing (fast 16.70, 2 mm gap 20.02 before and after: the spring cap never limited); an MR52 roller (contact r 2.5) raises the drive's own dK_lim 46.8 -> 49.0 at PA 43 with fast unchanged, but wearing that stroke unrefit (kK 2.8, a1max 57.5) gives frozen 21.33 (fold 86 -> 83, contact 10 -> 12), so a1max stays at the fit; with the wedge the same chain is 20.12 frozen. Measurement change landed during judging (commit 3ceacea, tools/simplicity.py v2, user 2026-10-17): the unsensed two-pin cuff knee scores 0, so the lead roller-longdyad-knuckle-3r is cx 24.25 (was 43.75) and kneeless-roller stays 23.75: deleting the knee now saves 0.5 complexity points for ~2.4 gap points, so every lens-3 drive simplification rides the lead first and keeps the proposer's kneeless chain as the measured control. tools/simplicity.py v2: lead + groove 22.0 (Kutzbach M -13, no flag), kneeless + groove 21.5. What it adds beyond the number: K is positively held at every pose (no preload for the cuff to fight, no stop-A drift; pick1's spring hold passes R17 only upright, 4.1-7.7 deg drift with the thorax tilted), and the groove is the hardware the dipped law's cx-19.75 embodiment needs.
model_spec: New file docs/concepts/models/groove-desmo-knuckle-3r.py loading roller-longdyad-knuckle-3r.py (lead cell) and kneeless-roller-knuckle-3r.py (control) unchanged. name: Dog-ring drag-link knuckle: a lost-motion ring coaxial with J2 drives K through a short spherical drag link (no lobe, no follower, no crank boss); judge: re-aimed at layering - the ring and drag link as specified cost +5.0-5.5 gap points of pooled in-band (merged dogring-equidyad-knuckle-3r as the 38/42 cell)
family: slaved-knuckle 3R (lead family with the free pin knee), long K dyad, positive linkage drive with a coaxial lost-motion dwell
lens: round11:coupler-longstroke (lens 1; merged dogring-equidyad-knuckle-3r, the 38/42 B1-exposure cell)
description: The slipper-nose lead's chain (stop A a1 37.55, a2 57.22, b3 tilt, pin knee) on a longer K dyad (34/46 primary; 32/48 and the merged 38/42 as cells; a1max = bk1 + bk2 - 5.5). The lead's lobe, bell crank, nose and flank are deleted; three parts replace them. (1) A thin 17-4PH ring turns on hub 2's O20 housing (iglidur sleeve or a 6704ZZ). (2) An integral 6 x 3 Ti arm on the ring lies along link 1b toward hub K (32.9 mm, 31.4 deg of arc) and ends in an O9 eye. (3) An 18.3 mm spherical drag link (16.6 deg) runs from that eye to a pin lug on link 1a at hub K's rim (r_h 15.1). Link 2 carries an O3 dowel 'dog' 12.5 mm from J2's axis. At rest (th below the onset th_hi = a1 + a2 - smhi, about 72.6-74.8 deg) the dog runs free (lost motion); K's spiral spring holds K on stop A, and the drag link then holds the ring parked. Overhead and across the body, past the onset, the dog meets the ring's radial lug face. The ring then turns 1:1 with q2 (same axis, PA 0, no sliding), and the drag link opens K 0 -> 75 deg over 33.3 deg of q2 (g 2.10-2.45, PA <= 33.6, PA-42 limit K 80.25), with a1e up to 72.3. Behind the back / folded side: the dog moves away and the ring and K stay parked, as in the lead. Every axis passes through GH. JUDGE: the ring as specified (annulus at link 1b's top + 0.15) sits 0.05-0.14 in band, and the drag link (stacked above the arm) 0.26-0.42. Pooled over every metal point they cost 0.061-0.065 of in-band14 against the chain alone (measured, round11_ideation.md section 1), about +5 gap points more than the lead's drive. The first build moves the ring to hub 2's skin-face layer as a C-ring / sector (measured -0.038) and lowers the drag link.
topology: scapula -> J1 (ACTIVE R, O20 hub) -> link 1a -> K (PASSIVE R, slaved, never read; stop A a1 37.55, stop B a1max = bk1 + bk2 - 5.5) -> link 1b -> J2 (ACTIVE R, hub 2) -> link 2 -> J3 (ACTIVE R, hub 3, b3 tilt) -> pin knee (2 PASSIVE R, unsensed) -> cuff / BOTTOM. K drive loop: link 2 -[dog: one-sided contact, coaxial with J2, PA 0, force-closed by K's spring]-> dog ring (PASSIVE R about J2's axis, on hub 2's housing) -[PASSIVE R, radial pin through GH]-> drag link -[PASSIVE R, radial pin through GH]-> link 1a horn at hub K. 0 passive translations, no gears, pulleys or cables. K is on its stop or set by q2 through the dog, so no coordinate is undetermined (the ring is fixed by the drag link while K rests).
components: Hubs unchanged: 2 x MR117-2RS (7 x 11 x 3) per O20 hub, 12.25 mm stack. Ring: 17-4PH H900, bore O20.4, OD ~27, 3 mm, on an iglidur GSM-2023-03 sleeve (20 x 23 x 3, part number from memory: confirm) or a 6704ZZ (20 x 27 x 4), retained by a DIN 6799 clip or the housing shoulder; judge variant: C-ring / sector on hub 2's skin-face layer. Ring arm: integral Ti-6Al-4V 6 x 3 strap, 31-33 deg (32.9-34.6 mm). Dog: ISO 8734 O3 x 8 m6 440C dowel pressed in a link-2 lug at r 12.5, bearing on a radial face of the ring lug. Drag link: Ti-6Al-4V 6 x 3 spherical strap, 16.6-16.7 deg (18.3-18.6 mm), two O9 x 6 eyes, each 2 x MR63ZZ (3 x 6 x 2.5) preloaded by a 0.1 mm wave washer on an O3 h6 radial pin. Horn: the lead's link-1a flank lug re-cut as a pin lug, pin at r_h 14.9-15.1 (eye >= 1 mm off hub K's O20: the seed has +0.4 / -0.03 mm). K return: the lead's spiral spring (1.4310 strip 0.3 x 5 x 145 mm, 0.080 N.m at stop A, ~0.10 at K 75). Stop B: q2 dowel at t 33.5 deg past the onset (34/46), 31.7 (32/48), 36.5 (38/42). Loads: ring torque 0.24-0.32 N.m, dog 19-26 N, drag link 8-11 N.
model_spec: About 75 min on the knuckle family code. (1) Copy docs/concepts/models/longstroke-slipper-knuckle-3r.py (LS_DRIVE=rssr path: per-pose drive members 8/9, _truncate, gate / frozen / held / flood / claims) to docs/concepts/models/dogring-draglink-knuckle-3r.py. (2) Law: override SC.FL.FLDesign.law with the dog law: a spherical-4R table with the ring axis = u2, phi = s_q t from the onset q2hi (smhi a parameter), the parents' per-t gates (dth > 0, rate <= 3.45, no lift-off, |K| <= dKB), no lobe PA / skirt gates (reference: law_from_kabs(..., lobe=False) in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-exo-shoulder/55c580fc-1103-56e5-9e17-3e425f438838/scratchpad/coupler_lens/law_probe.py; sph4r.py for pin_dir / solve). (3) Geometry: c1_0 = pin_dir(u2, uK, a1, t1), c2_0 = pin_dir(uK, u2, a3, t3), phi(K) by 0.25-deg continuation, PA at both pins; dK_lim = first K with PA > 42 or a drive part within 1 mm of hub 2 / hub K (r 10, base to crown), link 1b's strap or link 2's root. Seeds: 34/46 a1 31.43 t1 -4.05 a3 14.12 t3 -62.41 smhi 22; 32/48 a1 33.28 t1 -2.53 a3 13.93 t3 -66.06 smhi 20; 38/42 (merged cell) a1 27.78 t1 -3.26 a3 13.87 t3 -74.91 smhi 22 (table lim 85, PA <= 38.6). (4) Metal (member 9 = ring + arm, member 8 = drag link, horn on member 1; reference metal.py in the same folder): sample at bench density (~1 point / 4 mm2; the ring r 10.2-12.5 is ~39 points, NOT two 24-point circles) and price every layering with the judge's pooled harness /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-exo-shoulder/55c580fc-1103-56e5-9e17-3e425f438838/scratchpad/judge11/ib_dog.py / ib_dog_f2.py BEFORE any farm spend. Layer options, in this order: ring as a C-ring / sector on hub 2's skin-face layer (measured pooled delta -0.038 vs -0.065 as specified); arm azimuth t1 that takes the arm tip beside link 1b so the drag link drops a layer (sidecar rule: >= W_LINK/2 + 1 from the strap over the whole swing); the spec's stacked layout as the control. (5) Gates, in order: A law-only on Bench(110,360) + held out with dK <= dK_lim: >= 282 / 360 and >= 720 / 952 (re-based: the measured ceiling at these seats is 286-288 with any stage 1); 38/42 cell >= 276 / 700. lens: round12:stretched-wall (lens 1; merged desmo-spiral-rssr-knuckle-3r as the spring-free cell C and conecut-longdyad-knuckle-3r as the knee + J3-stop column)
description: AT REST: inband-rssr pick3's layout. J1's O20 hub on the scapula handler (acromion top and back, seat az 95 / el 68); link 1a (3 mm bent Ti) to hub K (O20, clock-spring cap, K shut on its stop-A dowel); link 1b down and lateral to hub 2 on the postero-lateral cap; link 2 to hub 3 (b3 tilt), the two-pin MR63ZZ cuff knee and the cuff. Beside hub 2 the bell crank on link 1b's joggled ear (MR63ZZ pair): short arm 4.0 mm on hub 2's rim lobe, long arm La 24 with a radial M2 ball stud, O3 Ti rod back along link 1b to the horn lug of link 1a at hub K (r_h 15.25). THE VISIBLE CHANGE: hub K sits 34 deg off the J1-J2 arc instead of 25 (az -18 / el 71 instead of az 16 / el 71), ~11 mm medially over the supraspinatus top; its clip-frame level rises 54 -> 59 mm. Hub 2's cap ring carries a log-spiral lobe: base circle r 8.0 (the dwell, K on stop A) rising to the 11.5 skirt over 23.1 deg of q2 at a constant 42 deg pressure angle; K stays shut for th <= a1 + a2 - 19.46 (th <= 75.6). OVERHEAD (elev 150-165): the follower climbs the spiral, K opens 40-80 deg, link 1b swings about hub K and carries J2 away from J1 (a1e 36.8 -> 76.5); the horn lug swings ~80 deg about hub K and is relieved LATERALLY toward K's axis (never lifted), with trimlug-k165's lug cut. ACROSS THE BODY with internal rotation >= 90 (64 of the lead's 73 stretched losses): the same opening, th 104.8-128.3 newly closed. BEHIND THE BACK / folded (th < 24.7): unchanged, K shut. CELL C (merged desmo-spiral-rssr-knuckle-3r): the same chain and RSSR with stage 1 cut as a 1.52 x 1.5 mm two-walled log-spiral track under hub 2's cap ring (pitch r 7.06 -> 9.66, 1.0 mm outer wall inside the O20 + 1.5 skirt) read by an ISO 8734 O1.5 m6 hardened dowel at 4.25 mm on the crank; no clock spring, K held positively both ways; stroke <= 60.6 deg at g 1.73. COLUMN (merged conecut-longdyad-knuckle-3r): pick conecut-knee-knuckle-3r's knee (lE 82, lc 27, phiE 3.8, phib -96.6, ang_min 25.22) and the J3 stop q3' >= -105 on every cell, because the long dyads add 3-6 knee fails (12-15 vs 9) that the lead's knee cannot close.
topology: scapula (user's handler, outside the count) -> J1 ACTIVE R (O20 hub) -> link 1a (3 mm Ti, horn lug at hub K) -> K PASSIVE R, slaved, never read (O20 hub, clock-spring cap [cell C: plain cap], stop-A dowel, stop B at bk1 + bk2 - 5.5) -> link 1b (joggled ear) -> J2 ACTIVE R (O20; link 2's cap ring carries the log-spiral rim lobe [cell C: the spiral track groove]) -> link 2 -> J3 ACTIVE R (O20, b3 tilt; column: hard stop q3' >= -105, tab on link 2's hub-3 root against the E strap root) -> member 3 -> two-pin cuff knee (2 PASSIVE R on MR63ZZ pairs, outside the count, no encoders) -> arm cuff. K-drive loops: spiral lobe (link 2) -> rolling follower on the crank's short arm [cell C: dowel sliding in the groove, positive both ways] -> crank PASSIVE R (MR63ZZ pair in link 1b's ear) -> radial M2 ball stud -> O3 Ti rod -> M2 ball link -> horn lug (link 1a). 0 passive translations.
components: J1 / K / J2 / J3: O20 v5 hub, 2x MR117-2RS (7 x 11 x 3), 12.25 mm stack (K: clock-spring cap, no encoder; cell C: plain cap). K clock spring 0.08 N.m preload + 0.015 N.m/rad (pick3's). Stop A: ISO 8734 O2 m6 dowel in an arc slot between link 1a and link 1b (K's own angle); stop B at bk1 + bk2 - 5.5. Crank: 2x MR63ZZ (3 x 6 x 2.5) in an O10 x 6 boss on a 3 mm Ti ear of link 1b joggled one layer down (pick3's clay 1); long arm 3 x 6 mm Ti, La 24. Rod: O3 Ti-6Al-4V. Ball links: M2 ball stud + O7 socket (STUD 3.5, CONE 30; a long-neck socket >= 30 deg cone, the red team found 25.5 of 30 used). Lobe: wire-EDM log spiral on hub 2's cap ring (17-4PH H900 or DLC Ti), base r 8.0, crest 11.5. Cell C: ISO 8734 O1.5 m6 440C dowel at 4.25 mm eccentricity, 1.52 x 1.5 groove pitch r 7.06 -> 9.66 in a 17-4PH H900 cap ring, no spring, no follower roller. Knee: 2x MR63ZZ pairs, built-in window stop [ang_min, 180 - ang_min], ang_min >= 25.22; column: E strap 8 x 3 Ti lE 82, knee link lc 27, J3 stop tab 3 x 2.5 x 2 mm on link 2 (or an ISO 8734 2 m6 dowel in an arc groove). Every part is the inband pick3 record (cell C removes the spring and the roller).

name: Desmo slipper: the lead with no clock spring and no stage-1 roller - a crowned pin in a 3-D skirt groove under hub 2's cap ring and a swept-envelope two-walled slot around the verified slipper nose (cell B: the pinned-horn inversion, nose on link 1a, slot in the crank tip)
family: slaved-knuckle 3R, positive-motion drive (lead family, pin knee)
lens: round12:spring-free-drive (lens 3, the planner's suggested id; merged pinned-horn-desmo-knuckle-3r as stage-2 cell B)
description: The verified lead slipper-nose-knuckle-3r 18.49: same seats, dyad 26/38.03, law kK 2.1534, g 2.3934, pin knee and O20 stacks; no part rides closer to the skin. (1) The clock spring, its 6 mm cap and stop A are deleted; hub K gets a plain O20 cap. (2) The stage-1 roller follower is deleted: a crowned 440C O1.5 pin pressed in the crank's short arm (8.6 mm from the crank axis) rides in a 1.52 x 1.5 groove cut in the underside of hub 2's cap ring, an O22 sector (outer wall r <= 10.98, inside the lead's own r 11.5 lobe skirt) over the dwell arc plus the rise (pitch 7.98 -> 9.42). (3) CELL A: the verified flank on link 1a's boss gets a second wall - the slot wire-EDM'd as the swept envelope of the O2.5 nose (union of nose discs + 0.01 mm), every convex material corner closed to R >= 1.0 (3.5 the conservative cell), a 1.5 mm wall on the free side of the nose where the nose metal sits >= 6.76 mm off the skin on every taken pose. At rest the nose sits at the slot's end cap (= stop A) and the groove's base circle holds the crank. CELL B (merged pinned-horn-desmo-knuckle-3r): the stage-2 pair inverted - the O2.5 nose pressed into an O5 boss on link 1a at the verified nose's rest position (r 15.37 from K's axis), the 4.18 mm two-walled slot in the crank's bent-arm tip (a ~5.4 x 9.6 plate), and the horn lug's 6 mm flank band deleted from the layer closest to the skin (the lug band is the lowest part on 71 of 371 taken poses, min 2.48 mm, and -7.07 / -5.34 mm at the two dwell contact poses). Overhead, across the body and behind the back it looks and moves like the lead.
topology: scapula handler -> base at J1 hub ring -> J1 (ACTIVE, O20 MR117 pair) -> link 1a -> K (PASSIVE, slaved, O20 plain cap, never read) -> link 1b -> J2 (ACTIVE, O20) -> link 2 -> J3 (ACTIVE, O20) -> member 3 -> pin knee (2 unsensed MR63ZZ-pair pins, cuff alignment, outside the count) -> arm pad on BOTTOM. Drive (two closed loops): link 2's cap groove =(sliding pair, positive both ways)= crowned pin on the crank's short arm; crank -(PASSIVE R, MR63ZZ pair on an O3 pin in link 1b)- link 1b; cell A: crank's bent long arm + pressed O2.5 nose =(sliding pair, positive both ways: swept slot)= link 1a's boss; cell B: slotted crank tip =(sliding, positive: swept slot)= nose fixed on link 1a. K is determined by q2 everywhere (the lead's dwell law: K = 0 on the slot's end cap for th <= a1 + a2 - 5). 0 passive translations, 0 springs.
components: J1 / K / J2 / J3: MR117-2RS pairs (7 x 11 x 3), O20 v5 stacks, 12.25 mm. Crank pivot: MR63ZZ pair (3 x 6 x 2.5) on an O3 pin in link 1b's boss (~6 mm stack, the lead's). Stage-1 follower: 440C O1.5 m6 gauge pin (ISO 8734 1.5 m6 blank) with a ground crown (SR ~1): the pin tilts 3.48 deg across the groove (0.091 mm run-out on 1.5 mm engagement vs 0.02 mm clearance), and the groove-desmo verifier found a straight dowel binds. Groove: 1.52 +0.01/0 x 1.5 deep, 5-axis or wire cut in a DLC Ti-6Al-4V cap ring or a pressed 17-4PH H900 ring; pitch r 7.98 -> 9.42, outer wall r 10.98. Stage-2 nose: ISO 8734 2.5 m6 440C (nose_r 1.25, the stock dowel the verifier measured 18.49 with). Cell A slot: 2.52 wide, a ruled cone through GH, 4-axis taper wire-EDM in link 1a's DLC Ti boss, 1.5 mm wall. Cell B: the dowel pressed 3 mm into an O5 x 3 boss on link 1a's root arm; the slot in the crank's 3 mm Ti tip (DLC, greased), 1.5 mm walls. Deleted: clock spring, stop-A pin, the stage-1 roller (and in cell B the lug's flank band). Knee: 2x MR63ZZ pairs.

STAGE 2 CELL A: keep RF's inner-flank synthesis and limiters (PA <= 43 - atan(mu), inner cusp, contact r >= 13, hub-K and arm clearances); add the outer wall as groove-desmo does (offsets P1 - (nose_r + 0.01 + s) N1, s in {0.3, 1.0, 1.8}, end caps; keep the filter that drops wall points within nose_r + 0.3 of the path = the swept envelope); replace 'wall2_cusp' by SLOP (crank held at phi(K0) on a 0.5-deg K0 grid, K stepped +-0.005 deg until the closed nose disc nose_r + rho_e leaves the union of discs nose_r + rho_e + 0.01 along the 0.02-deg path; rho_e 1.0 and 3.5; fail if one-sided slop > 0.25 deg) and the outer-wall PA (PA + atan(mu) <= 43); sample the wall as horn metal. STAGE 1 (both cells): the exact 3-D follower F0 = s dR + a_s v at the cap level PV.u2 + 3.15, path in link 2 rotm(u2, K/kK) rotm(dR, sig K/g) F0; per K step pitch in [7.06, 9.94], PA on follower and cap side <= 43 - atan(0.087), centreline radius >= 1.5, axial drift <= 0.6, across-groove tilt reported (crown if > 0.5 deg); groove ring sampled as link-2 metal (member 2) from r 6.3 to pitch + 1.56 over the dwell + rise azimuths; pin and short arm as crank metal; groove-desmo's l2_check with the true 3-D pin. Remove capK (0), stop A and the roller head; blend the K law over 4 deg of q2 at the onset (75-deg groove corner); report the K shift and min th margin. JUDGE ADDITION: the cell-A slot sits at the crank / link-1a relative pole over K 0-8 (the nose moves ~0.18 mm in link 1a's frame): measure slop and jam in the MODEL with the crank held AND free, both directions, including the reversal at the dwell exit, before any bench number. Gate (<= 25 min): both stages to dK >= 46.3 at mu 0.087, slop <= 0.25 deg, groove outer wall <= 11.5, law-only closure >= 272. Kill: no stage-1 placement survives the l2 / arm / boss checks to 46.3 -> report the binder and fall back to the stage-2-only slot with the spring kept. Then: pair-coverage table; pre-register cell A or B on envsel; frozen exact Bench(110,360) vs 18.49 with the tie rule; held out; full + knn flood; T5 per-pose dump; m_sub rest / moved; min th margin with the slop band and the +0.75 deg K lead; tools/simplicity.py v2.2 on the full record; viz preview docs/concepts/viz/concepts/desmo-slipper-knuckle-3r.js.
